verdict.rationale: LM Studio is local-first, so data stays on whatever machine the user chooses. Models run locally, document RAG works entirely offline, Bionic voice data is processed on-device and never leaves it, and the headless llmster daemon can be deployed on the user's own servers or cloud instances. That gives de facto control over where data lives, but there is no documented region/residency selection or statement covering where any cloud-backed features (e.g., Bionic with frontier models) store data. Missing for 10: explicit data-residency or region controls, documentation of storage location for all data including any hosted components, independent corroboration of the local-only data claims.
